title: Output Presentations
page_title: Output Presentations | Edexcel IGCSE ICT Revision Notes 2017

blocks.text: What are the different methods of outputting a presentation?

blocks.md:
- The two most common methods of outputting a presentation are **on screen** and **printed**
- On screen presentations can be displayed in a variety of ways including:

  - **Looped on screen carousel**
  - **Presenter controlled**

blocks.alt: PowerPoint presentation slide titled "Base Metal Mining: Around the world" with sidebar showing five slides including a title and content slides.
blocks.caption: Setting display options in a presentation

blocks.md: - Both options can be configured using the** Slide Show tab** and selecting '**Set Up Slide Show**'

- When printing a presentation, **a variety of layouts** can be selected, including:

  - **Full page slides**
  - **Presenter notes**
  - **Handouts**
- Printing options can be found in when using the **File tab** and selecting '**Print**'
